paper_title: First search for axion dark matter with a Madmax prototype
notes: MADMAX dielectric haloscope prototype (CB200) first axion DM search. Two narrow mass windows: 76.56-76.82 ueV (config 1) and 79.31-79.53 ueV (config 2). 95% CL upper limit reaching ~2e-11 GeV^-1 at best sensitivity (~76.74 ueV). Exact bin-by-bin limits from Fig. 4/S7 not tabulated; data points are approximate representative values (endpoints of ranges ~3-4e-11, minimum ~2e-11). Local DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
